subject.title: feat(dashboard): pinned MCP apps — board rendering, lease re-mint, durable tool grants

question: Should pinned dashboard MCP Apps reserve or otherwise coordinate durable board-owned leases within the shared global MCP App lease capacity, or should the product impose a lower mounted-widget limit?
rationale: The implementation cannot safely choose between board-owned lifecycle capacity, visible-widget virtualization, or a product-facing widget limit without deciding the intended V1 ownership and resource contract.

options.title: Board-owned lease budget
options.body: Reserve or manage board-widget leases within a documented shared budget so mounted dashboard apps cannot evict each other unpredictably.

options.title: Explicit mounted-app limit
options.body: Keep the shared lease model but cap or virtualize mounted MCP App widgets below the global capacity and surface the limit in the UI.

recommendation.title: Board-owned lease budget
recommendation.body: Reserve or manage board-widget leases within a documented shared budget so mounted dashboard apps cannot evict each other unpredictably.

likelyOwner.reason: The available commit trail connects this contributor directly to the proposed board and MCP App lifecycle design.
